requirements.name: Phased-array / beamforming signal processing
requirements.note: Job title is 'Signal Processing Engineer' but the described duties are entirely optical metrology and environmental qualification; per refuse-to-guess rule, the title alone is not treated as evidence of phased-array or beamforming work.

requirements.name: RF measurement experience
requirements.note: CV describes optical measurement (MTF, distortion mapping, stray-light) and environmental qualification, not RF measurement; cover letter states 'What I have not done is work in the core technical area your posting describes.'

requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent
requirements.note: CV states an MSc in Process Engineering, which is not explicitly one of the fields named in the requirement (electrical engineering, physics, applied mathematics, or closely adjacent); whether it or the candidate's metrology/test-engineering background counts as closely adjacent or demonstrated equivalent is a judgement for the recruiter.

lines.quote: Contributing author on a paper in Applied Optics (2018): "Adaptive Optical Alignment Compensation for Thermal Drift in High-Speed Industrial Inspection Systems"
Finnish citizen since 2004; full EU work authorisation

Served as English-language technical liaison for Sinikaari's partnership with a Japanese photodetector manufacturer since 2015, handling specification reviews, test-report translations, and quarterly progress meetings
Based at Sinikaari's Oulu headquarters since 2000

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have designing or implementing phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ that runs on real hardware under real timing constraints, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing Python to production or engineering standards used by others, if any?
Can you describe any hands-on RF test-bench or measurement experience you have, if any?
